items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: that's a reminder when I went to school with, with, with, uh, Zieg Bonura.

ctx.x: You wouldn't, you wouldn't hear, hear much of that in the, at Mardi Gras? No.

Well, I, I don't think so. I mean, of course a lot, of French people would be talking French, but I, that's a reminder when I went to school with, with, with, uh, Zieg Bonura. Yeah. Brother Albert, he speak to my mother on the phone, you understand? Mm-hmm. So I'm going to school and, and right away, he's speaking to my mother, he's speaking French to my mother, you understand? Mm-hmm. And my father or somebody, he'll speak French to me. Then he figured, well, I'm going to put this kid of yours in the French…
